question: What is the trophic level of dead organic matter in detritus food chain?
solution:
The correct answer is __**first.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **detritus food chain** starts with the **dead organic matter, **which is then consumed by detritivores such as **earthworms, snails, and bacteria.**
 
• The dead organic matter is also known as** detritus,** and it is the** primary source of energy** for the detritus food chain.
 
• Since the dead organic matter is the** initial source of energy,** it is considered to be at the first trophic level.
 
• The detritus food chain is important as it helps in the** recycling of nutrients** in the ecosystem.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** fourth trophic level** refers to the **tertiary consumers**, which are organisms that feed on the** secondary consumers**.

 
 
• These are usually **top predators** in the food chain.
 
 
 
• The **second trophic level **refers to the primary consumers, which are **herbivores.**
 
 
• They feed on **producers.**
 
 
 
• The** third trophic level **refers to the secondary consumers, which are **carnivores.**
 
 
• They feed on the** primary consumers.**
